blocks.text: The Programme has received a separate complaint about the lawn.

It is understood that over the summer the rear lawn was mown shorter in a circle near the patio, a hole was cut, and a small flag on a pole was inserted. It is further understood that the flag was a present from Keith. Sue describes the garden as "a pitch and putt with a rotary washing line", and the children have been told the flag is a no-go area. Poppy has been told off twice for moving it.
The flag is to be removed and returned to Keith. The circle may grow back in its own time. The children may now play anywhere, including on the green.

blocks.label: Case notes (Sue), Day 16
blocks.text: He mowed the lawn. The whole lawn. Then he stood at the kitchen window for twenty minutes looking at the stripes like he'd painted the Sistine Chapel. I'll take it.
